scope: resolved_tissue@5 with HCN1/2/4, NaV1.2, Kv1.5 and Kir2.1. One intrinsic gate pair and availability per population, with separate Na/K/Ca routes and transfer/energy ledgers. Four synthetic 2-ms two-cell/four-patch/five-outside cases; ten populations, finite calcium ions and maintained Na/K pumps. Source/numerical qualification on CPU/L4, not measured physiology or full native BETSE tissue equivalence.
checks: Distinct resolved_tissue@5 schema/layout: one m/h gate pair per channel population, permeability matrix indexed species/population, and nineteen state arrays with species/population axes for channel transfer and heat. Legacy layouts retain their original shapes and catalogs.

Explicit law-specific ordered permeability routes. Na:K:Ca is 0.2:1:0.05 for HCN1/2/4, valences 1/1/2. Invalid species, ratios, ordering, gates, capacity, controls, temperature, model identity and timestep reject. cAMP variants are unsupported.

Unmodified pinned BETSE capture in a separate environment, checked file hashes and version; 61 voltages per family across -120 to +60 mV, target/time constants against native and independent 80-digit Decimal. Three 32-update native semi-implicit clocks per family at 25 us, 100 us and 1 ms. The clocks do not define the coupled RK4 solver.

Continuous 200-ms analytic clamps at 1/0.5/0.25 ms, finite autodiff, correct hyperpolarization sign and opening m independent of h. This extends gate-only relaxation checks, not the two-millisecond coupled horizon.

Eight compact/padded stage comparisons against independent full-node roots, Decimal gates/transport/pumps and separate owner arithmetic. Shared population blocking stops all three ion routes while intrinsic gates continue. Calcium contributes divalent charge and its own heat.

Missing species routes and hidden transfer/heat reject. Equal-valence opposite ledger corruption must fail material accounting despite zero net charge. Species-route heat decreases must fail even when summed heat is unchanged. Unknown and nonzero padded law codes reject.

Legacy sodium/potassium initial fields and derivatives reduce bitwise after explicit ledger reindexing. Existing schema/batch tests are separate regressions. Earlier sodium/calcium compiled and independent-rate preflights are tracked in Progress, not counted as new biological cases.

The HCN independent adaptive reference uses rtol 1e-13, amount/energy/gate atol 1e-16 and charge atol 5e-32, while earlier families retain their previous defaults. Clamped/release references must agree with a further fourfold tightening within 3e-14 per non-charge state and 3e-28 C, below the unchanged refinement floors. GPU reuses these CPU controls only after exact inputs, settings, state and passed-status checks. The failed predecessor and original reference are preserved; no production equation or acceptance threshold changes.

Four complete coupled trajectories versus segmented DOP853, full-state conservation/energy/source-work checks, release gates evolve before transport starts, and clamped/release refinement at 2.5/1.25/0.625 us. Independent CPU references reused on GPU only with exact serialized-input and passed-status checks.

Complete disk/fresh-process/terminal restart, future branch, changed window sizes, independent-world reorder/partition/restart clocks and ordinary ionic ensemble. Changed HCN law or transported species/law keeps a distinct physical identity. Heterogeneous worlds match their standalone histories bitwise and an independent full-state reference.
Invalid controls and failed compiled trial steps retain all state arrays. Complete CPU/L4 histories/readouts use the inherited physical tolerances; exact same-backend replay is required.

Host planning checks twelve arm/timestep grids and two-world aggregate work before integration. Two-world allowance 2048 padded steps, 512 MiB working storage; 2 GiB trace bound. These are resource bounds, not accuracy changes.

Fresh serial process groups bound compilation memory; all registered tests execute exactly once per backend. Repeated fixtures retain original group artifacts and are not independent cases. Source/evidence hashes, durable completion/failure, GPU busy and measured SM-active with coverage/time. No automatic follow-up.

Each refinement timestep saves exact inputs, observed/reference state arrays, field shapes and signed maximum discrepancies before accuracy assertions. Failed refinement reports preserve available values and remain failed; they cannot count as passing evidence.
scope_exclusions: Finite calcium ions are transported by the HCN routes; this family does not compose owned ER/calcium/IP3 chemistry, CaV, plasma calcium transport or assembly regulation. Those require a separately checked composition.

Pinned coefficients and permeability ratios are source correspondence, not new biological measurements. No cAMP modulation, temperature fitting, action-potential validation or measured pacemaking claim.

Fixed small manufactured geometry and calcium background, maintained ATP/ADP/Pi, 298.15 K, voltage domain -120 to +60 mV and RK4 step cap 2.5 us. No arbitrary-regime, long-time coupled or spatial-convergence claim.

The source constant reversal-voltage attribute is not used; each route uses concentration-dependent GHK transport. Native isolated gate/clock agreement is distinct from continuous RK4 tissue verification.

Numerical clamps, refinements, legacy reductions, tamper/replay controls and repeated group fixtures are not independent biological cases. Parked two-task/channel-compensation research is not resumed.

Independent GPU worlds use shared execution and full checkpoints. No Jupiter or interacting-tissue multi-GPU qualification. Whole-phase utilization includes compilation/host work, with no throughput or 70-percent utilization gate.
